A [[Color|pink]]-skinned '''Twi'lek''' worked in a [[Unidentified kingpin|kingpin]]'s [[Unidentified casino (Duro)|casino]] on the [[planet]] of [[Duro]]<ref name="TOTU 104" /> during the [[Republic Era]]. Between around [[62 BBY]] and [[33 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the individual helped the kingpin toss out a [[Unidentified Rodian casino customer|Rodian customer]] through the back door, an incident that was witnessed by the two [[Duros]] [[youngling]]s [[Cad Bane|Colby]] and [[Niro]]. Some [[time]] later, the Twi'lek was standing at the kingpin's side when he greeted a [[Unidentified human casino customer|human customer]] at the front door, located inside [[The Corner Shop]]. The [[human]] visited the establishment again on the following [[Standard day|day]], again greeted by the kingpin in the company of his Twi'lek employee.<ref name="TOTU 104" />

The Twi'lek [[casino]] worker had pink skin and cone-shaped hearing organs. When at work, the individual was dressed in a dark-green sleeveless [[Clothing|top]] with matching pants, in addition to dark arm wraps and an [[earth]]-toned [[Hat|headgear]].<ref name="TOTU 104" />

==Behind the scenes==
The [[Twi'lek]] first appeared in the "[[The Good Life]]," an episode of the animated television miniseries ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Underworld]]'',<ref name="TOTU 104" /> which was released on [[May 4]], [[2025]].<ref name="Trailer">{{SWYouTube|GkywNANueew|Tales of the Underworld | Official Trailer | Available May 4 on Disney+}}</ref>
